title: Say Imon ya Angupot
intro: Sakey a salaysay a mas daan nen say antokaman a panarian odino kasulatan—say sankaunaan a trahedya na too a nanlapud imon. Sakey a kamarerwa, say panguloan ed duaran anak ya inyanak na inmunan atateng, so nanbantay ed sanok to legan ya say yugtan ton agi so akaawat na pabor ya ag-inawat. Say tinmumbok et say sankabilungetan ed saray pinili, ya angitilak na sankaunaan ya dala ya inkalbo ed dalin. Sarag mon iparungtal so pakabidbiran, say subok, tan say ampait a pagbabawi?
clues: Nianak ak ed sankaunaan ya paris na totoon nambilay ed dalin.
Aminsan et angiyapay ak ed si Allah, balet ag ko itan inawat.
Inawat so apay nen agik, bangta say apay ko et ag-inawat​—bengatlan agko nitepel.
Tinaktakot koy mismon agik ya deralen.
Siak so sankaunaan ya akapatey ed sayan dalin, ya inala koy bilay na mismon agik.

Angibaki si Allah na sakey a pinalsa ed dalin—sakey ya andeket a manok ya mankokotkot ed dalin—pian ibangat to ak no panon kon iyamot so ginawak, tan anggapo lay natilak ed siak noag say pagbabawian ko.

outcome.answer: Nagmaliw ya napno na pagbabawi tan kaiba ed saray abalang

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
